description: When a Bulgarian identity card, passport or driving license expires, when a car's technical inspection is due, the vignette periods, and the local tax dates (moved to the next working day when they fall on a non-working day) — each rule with its official source. Works the date out only where the rule is unambiguous (e.g. an ID card issued at 18–70 is valid 10 years); otherwise says so and the person reads the date on the document.

birthDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, for ID cards and passports (validity depends on age at issue).

category.description: Driving license category, e.g. B or C1E.

firstRegistration.description: YYYY-MM-DD the car was first registered as new.

issuedOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD the document was issued (for an inspection: the latest passed one).

year.description: For local taxes: the year (default this year).

name: document_deadline

citations.description: Every source the result rests on. Cite url; give checkedOn or publishedOn.
